stories.title: CFP top 12 projection: What we learned in the regular season's penultimate week
stories.summary: We assess how the selection committee could stack the top teams in the country after Week 12.

stories.title: Sources: Mayfield dealing with plantar fasciitis, determined to keep playing
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield is dealing with a painful case of plantar fasciitis, sources told NFL Network, an injury that the Bucs QB is determined to play through.

stories.title: Wemby makes history in 18 minutes, finishes game with 50 points
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama had his third career 50-point outing during a win over the Pelicans to go along with 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals.

stories.title: Verstappen mocks 'complete joke' Russell at Las Vegas GP as feud intensifies
stories.summary: Max Verstappen ridiculed George Russell after the Las Vegas Grand Prix, laughing at the Mercedes driver's late mistake and branding his 2026 season a "complete joke."

stories.title: Ex-Colts QB Jones likely to wait before signing with new team, sources say
stories.summary: If Daniel Jones clear waivers and becomes a free agent, the QB is unlikely to sign immediately, preferring to wait for the right opportunity, sources said.
